reasoning: Contains a non-obvious text-parsing layer that converts human-readable MCP tool responses into typed TypeScript objects using regex parsers. The two MCP list/search tools return structurally different text formats requiring separate parsers, and all parsed thought IDs are ephemeral (generated via crypto.randomUUID). These are genuine gotchas not evident from file names.

module_summary.purpose: Shared data layer providing domain types, a Supabase browser client, and an MCP API client with text-response parsing
